name: rad-brainstorm
description: User-led brainstorming for Codex. It keeps generation separate from evaluation and supports quick sessions, full sessions, problem framing, idea evaluation, and software design.

interface.shortDescription: Think first, then build better ideas with Codex.
interface.longDescription: RAD Brainstorm is a one-person, text-first thinking partner. It asks for the user's ideas first, labels user, AI, and research contributions, checks for distinct mechanisms, and keeps generation separate from evaluation. It supports quick and full sessions, Five Whys problem framing, structured idea evaluation, and software design. It never implements application code.
defaultPrompt: Run a quick brainstorm on this topic.
Help me explore this idea without anchoring me on your answers.
Use Five Whys to find the root cause of this problem.
Help me compare these ideas before I choose one.
Turn this chosen software idea into a reviewable design spec.
